content.text: Yã́ pↄ́ Dii ò Damasi musun kɛ: Gwa! Damasi aↄ dɛ wɛ̃́lɛ ũ lↄo,
aↄ dↄdↄaa lán zɛ̀tɛ̃ kwɛawaɛ.
Aloee wɛ̃́lɛↄ gↄ̃ bɛzia ũ,
aↄ dɛ pↄ́ↄ kákĩi ũ.
Gbɛ̃e aↄ ku we
kɛ́ a vĩa gbasa pↄ́piↄ kũo.
Ɛflaiũ buiↄ wɛ̃́lɛ bĩ́ideↄ aↄ ku lↄo,
Damasi kpala aↄ ku lↄo.
Sili gbɛ̃́ kĩninaↄ gↄ̃ lala'onaↄ ũ lán Isailiↄwaɛ.
Dii Zĩgↄ̃de mɛ́ ò.
Zĩ́ bee Yakↄbu buiↄ gawi kↄ a ɛ́,
an namablea a midɛ.
An bùsu a gↄ̃ lán bua pↄ́ wà a pↄ́ kɛ̀kɛ wà ↄmàlɛuwaɛ,
lán Lefai guzulɛ pↄ́ wà a pↄ́ kↄ̃nwɛ̀wa.
Kási a kↄ̃napi a gi gↄ̃ yↄↄ
lán ku pↄ́ wa kɛ̀ a nɛ́ mɛ̀n pla ge àaↄ̃ gì gↄ̃̀ a musu
mɛ́ a nɛ́ mɛ̀n síiↄ̃ ge sↄo gì gↄ̃̀ a gↄ̃n nɛdewawaɛ.
Dii Isailiↄ Lua mɛ́ ò.
Gↄↄ bee gbɛ̃nazĩnaↄ wɛ́ aↄ pɛ ń Kɛnawa,
aa wɛsi Isailiↄ Lua Kuaadoadelɛ.
An wɛ́ aↄ ku sa'okĩi pↄ́ aa bò ńzĩaɛↄwa lↄo,
aa wɛdↄ lí pↄ́ aa pɛ̀lɛ tã́a ũↄzi lↄo ge ń tulaletikatɛakĩiↄ.
Gↄↄ bee an wɛ̃́lɛ bĩ́ideↄ a gↄ̃ bɛzia ũ,
aa gↄ̃ daaĩa lán Amↄleↄ ń Iviↄ wɛ̃́lɛↄwa
gↄↄ pↄ́ aa ń tó Isailiↄnɛ.
Asa Lua á Suabana yã́ sã̀águɛ,
Lua á gbãa á ulɛkĩi yã́ i dↄáguo.
Ayãmɛto a dↄ̀ↄsagbɛ pɛ̀lɛ,
a buade pɛ̀ lá buipãleↄ ì kɛwa.
Zĩ́ pↄ́ á bà a kaa lìai,
a gu dↄ̀ á tò à bↄlↄbↄ̀.
Kási á pↄe e weo,
sema gyã ń yã'ↄ̃ma láasaio.
Ó'o! Buiↄ zↄa dↄ dasidasi
lán ísia kↄ̃fĩwa.
Ó'o! Gbɛ̃nazĩnaↄ kĩ́i dↄ
lán izↄ̃ↄsukaawa.
Tó buiↄ kĩ́ipi dↄ
lán izↄ̃ↄsukaawa màa,
Dii a ń lele, aai bàalɛ ta zã̀zã
lán ése ṹa pↄ́ ĩ́ana sɛ̀lɛ sĩ̀sĩ musuwa,
lán ĩ́ampuuvu pↄ́ zàa'ĩana gɛ̃̀ò zɛ́awa.
Tó oosi kɛ̀, sↄ̃kɛ̃ngu a mɛ á kɛ́!
E gu àↄ gɛ́ dↄi yã́ a láa.
Gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ aaì wá pↄ́ↄ sɛ́lɛↄ baan we,
gbɛ̃́ pↄ́ aaì wá pↄ́ↄ naaaↄ zian we.
